author: Kevin Stratvert
description: It’s the season for the big summer tech conferences. In this episode, Kevin and Nick discuss the big takeaways from Google I/O, Microsoft Build, and WWDC. Plus, Anthropic released a powerful new AI model, Fable 5, but immediately suspended it. Hear all about Kevin’s experiences using Fable 5 before it was pulled, as well as some perspective on what it means for the larger AI ecosystem.
title: Tech Conference Roundup

author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This Lovable AI tutorial for beginners shows you how to build a real app from plain English, with no code, and put it right on your phone. ❤️ Try it free and build along with me ➜ https://lovable.kevinstratvert.com 

First, you'll learn what makes a good prompt for Lovable, so the AI builds the app you actually pictured instead of guessing. 

Next, you'll turn on Plan mode and watch Lovable map out the whole app before it spends a single credit building it. Then you'll watch Lovable turn that plain-English description into a real, working app, wired up to the outside services it needs. 

Along the way, you'll refine your app with simple follow-up prompts, change the design, and add new features, all without writing code. After that, you'll add real user sign-in so other people can safely use what you built, and run Lovable's built-in security scan to catch issues before you go live.
